text_en: Some time passed. David’s son Absalom had a beautiful sister whose name was Tamar; and David’s son Amnon fell in love with her.
text_cn: 此后，发生了一件事：达味的儿子阿贝沙隆有个妹妹，名叫塔玛尔，很是美丽，达味的儿子阿默农很爱她。

text_en: Amnon was so tormented that he made himself ill because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin and it seemed impossible to Amnon to do anything to her.
text_cn: 阿默农为了他妹妹塔玛尔的缘故，竟忧闷成疾；因为她还是处女，所以在阿默农看来，对她行事几乎不可能。

text_en: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah; and Jonadab was a very crafty man.
text_cn: 阿默农有个朋友，名叫约纳达布，是达味的兄弟史默亚的儿子。约纳达布是一个很狡猾的人。

text_en: He said to him, “O son of the king, why are you so haggard morning after morning? Will you not tell me? ” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister. ”
text_cn: 他向阿默农说：“太子，为什么你一天一天如此萎靡不振？你不肯告诉我吗？”阿默农回答说：“我爱上我兄弟阿贝沙隆的妹妹塔玛尔。”

text_en: Jonadab said to him, “Lie down on your bed, and pretend to be ill; and when your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Let my sister Tamar come and give me something to eat, and prepare the food in my sight, so that I may see it and eat it from her hand. ’”
text_cn: 约纳达布向他说：“你躺在床上装病，你父亲来看你时，你就对他说：我很希望我的妹妹塔玛尔来，给我准备食物，她要在我眼前准备，叫我看着，并由她手中取食。”

text_en: So Amnon lay down, and pretended to be ill; and when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of cakes in my sight, so that I may eat from her hand. ”
text_cn: 阿默农就卧床装病，君王来看他时，阿默农向君王说：“求你叫我妹妹塔玛尔来，在我眼前做两块饼，好叫我从她手中取食。”

text_en: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him. ”
text_cn: 达味就派人到塔玛尔房中说：“请你到你哥哥阿默农房里去，给他准备食物。”

text_en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house, where he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.
text_cn: 塔玛尔到了她哥哥阿默农房里，他正躺在床上。她取了面，在他眼前和好，烤成饼。

text_en: Then she took the pan and set them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Send out everyone from me. ” So everyone went out from him.
text_cn: 她就拿过锅来，在他面前将饼倒出，他却推辞不吃。阿默农说：“你叫众人都由我面前出去。”众人就都由他面前出去了。

text_en: Then Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the chamber, so that I may eat from your hand. ” So Tamar took the cakes she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
text_cn: 阿默农对塔玛尔说：“你给我把食物带到内室来，好叫我由你手中取食。”塔玛尔拿着她做的饼，进了内室，送到她哥哥阿默农前。

text_en: But when she brought them near him to eat, he took hold of her, and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister. ”
text_cn: 她正递给他吃时，他就抓住她说：“我的妹妹，来与我同寝！”

text_en: She answered him, “No, my brother, do not force me; for such a thing is not done in Israel; do not do anything so vile!
text_cn: 她回答说：“我的哥哥！不可这样，不要作贱我！在以色列不应作这样的事，不要作这愚蠢的事！

text_en: As for me, where could I carry my shame? And as for you, you would be as one of the scoundrels in Israel. Now therefore, I beg you, speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from you. ”
text_cn: 我带着这耻辱往哪里去呢？你在以色列也成了一个愚妄人。请你向君王说明，他决不会拒绝使我属于你的！”

text_en: But he would not listen to her; and being stronger than she, he forced her and lay with her.
text_cn: 他却不肯听她的话，又比她有力，就强奸了她。

text_en: Then Amnon was seized with a very great loathing for her; indeed, his loathing was even greater than the lust he had felt for her. Amnon said to her, “Get out! ”
text_cn: 事后，阿默农立即十分憎恨她，并且他如今对她的憎恨，远超过他以前对她的爱恋，就向她说：“起来，走吧！”

text_en: But she said to him, “No, my brother; for this wrong in sending me away is greater than the other that you did to me. ” But he would not listen to her.
text_cn: 她答说：“我的哥哥！那不可以。你赶我走，比你对我所行的，更为无理！”他却不愿听从她，

text_en: He called the young man who served him and said, “Put this woman out of my presence, and bolt the door after her. ”
text_cn: 就叫服侍自己的仆人来，向他说：“把这女人从我这里赶出去！她走后，随锁上门！”

text_en: (Now she was wearing a long robe with sleeves; for this is how the virgin daughters of the king were clothed in earlier times. ) So his servant put her out, and bolted the door after her.
text_cn: 她那时穿着彩色长衣，因为君王的女儿，在未出嫁以前，昔日都是如此装束。他的仆人将她赶出去，随后锁上了门。

text_en: But Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore the long robe that she was wearing; she put her hand on her head, and went away, crying aloud as she went.
text_cn: 塔玛尔把灰撒在头上，撕破自己所穿的彩色长衣，双手抱着头，一路边哭边走。

text_en: Her brother Absalom said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? Be quiet for now, my sister; he is your brother; do not take this to heart. ” So Tamar remained, a desolate woman, in her brother Absalom’s house.
text_cn: 她的哥哥阿贝沙隆问她说：“莫非你的哥哥阿默农与你同寝了？妹妹，暂且不要出声，因为他是你的兄弟，不可把这事放在心上！”塔玛尔从此就忧闷不乐，住在她哥哥阿贝沙隆家里。

text_en: When King David heard of all these things, he became very angry, but he would not punish his son Amnon, because he loved him, for he was his firstborn.
text_cn: 达味王听说了这一切事，十分生气；但他不愿伤他儿子阿默农的心，因为他是长子，格外爱他。

text_en: But Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had raped his sister Tamar.
text_cn: 至于阿贝沙隆，无论好话歹话，一句也不向阿默农说。他恼恨阿默农，因为他污辱了他妹妹塔玛尔。

text_en: After two full years Absalom had sheepshearers at Baal-hazor, which is near Ephraim, and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
text_cn: 过了两年，当阿贝沙隆在厄弗辣因的巴耳哈祚尔剪羊毛的时节，阿贝沙隆邀请了君王所有的儿子。

text_en: Absalom came to the king, and said, “Your servant has sheepshearers; will the king and his servants please go with your servant? ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆来到君王前说：“看，到了你仆人剪羊毛的时节，请君王带着臣仆都到你仆人那里去！”

text_en: But the king said to Absalom, “No, my son, let us not all go, or else we will be burdensome to you. ” He pressed him, but he would not go but gave him his blessing.
text_cn: 君王回答阿贝沙隆说：“我儿，不必如此！我们不必都去麻烦你。”他虽然恳求，君王仍不愿去，只祝福了他。

text_en: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us. ” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you? ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆便说：“至少让我的兄弟阿默农同我们一起去！”君王回答说：“为什么要他同你一起去？”

text_en: But Absalom pressed him until he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him. Absalom made a feast like a king’s feast.
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆还是再三恳求，达味便派阿默农和君王所有的儿子，同他一起去了。阿贝沙隆摆设筵席，好像御筵。

text_en: Then Absalom commanded his servants, “Watch when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say to you, ‘Strike Amnon, ’ then kill him. Do not be afraid; have I not myself commanded you? Be courageous and valiant. ”
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆吩咐他的仆人说：“你们要注意！阿默农畅饮的时候，我向你们说：刺死阿默农！你们就打死他，不要害怕，是我吩咐了你们，要大胆勇敢。”

text_en: So the servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons rose, and each mounted his mule and fled.
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆的仆人，就照他所吩咐的，对阿默农做了。君王所有的儿子遂起身，各自骑上骡子逃跑了。

text_en: While they were on the way, the report came to David that Absalom had killed all the king’s sons, and not one of them was left.
text_cn: 他们还在路上，消息已传到达味前说：“阿贝沙隆杀了君王所有的儿子，没有一个幸免。”

text_en: The king rose, tore his garments, and lay on the ground; and all his servants who were standing by tore their garments.
text_cn: 君王便起来，撕裂了自己的衣服，俯伏在地；他身边的臣仆，也都撕裂了自己的衣服。

text_en: But Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah, said, “Let not my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men the king’s sons; Amnon alone is dead. This has been determined by Absalom from the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.
text_cn: 达味的兄弟史默亚的儿子约纳达布说道：“我主不要想：所有的青年，君王所有的儿子都被杀了；其实只有阿默农一人死了。自从阿默农污辱了他的妹妹塔玛尔那日起，阿贝沙隆就决定了这事。

text_en: Now therefore, do not let my lord the king take it to heart, as if all the king’s sons were dead; for Amnon alone is dead. ”
text_cn: 我主君王，且不要将这事放在心上，以为君王所有的儿子都死了，因为只有阿默农一人死了。”

text_en: But Absalom fled. When the young man who kept watch looked up, he saw many people coming from the Horonaim road by the side of the mountain.
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆逃走了。守卫的仆人举目一望，看见在往曷洛纳因山坡的路上，有一大群人下来。守卫的就去报告君王说：“我看见一群人，从曷洛纳因山坡的路上下来了。”

text_en: Jonadab said to the king, “See, the king’s sons have come; as your servant said, so it has come about. ”
text_cn: 约纳达布就向君王说：“看，君王的儿子回来了，正如你仆人所说的，现在实现了。”

text_en: As soon as he had finished speaking, the king’s sons arrived, and raised their voices and wept; and the king and all his servants also wept very bitterly.
text_cn: 他刚说完这话，君王的儿子都来到了，放声大哭；君王和他的众臣仆，也都号咷痛哭。

text_en: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son day after day.
text_cn: 同时，阿贝沙隆逃到革叔尔王阿米胡得的儿子塔耳买那里去了。 君王天天哀悼自己的儿子。

text_en: Absalom, having fled to Geshur, stayed there three years.
text_cn: 阿贝沙隆逃到革叔尔，在那里住了三年。

text_en: And the heart of the king went out, yearning for Absalom; for he was now consoled over the death of Amnon.
text_cn: 此时，君王的心渐渐不再恼怒阿贝沙隆，对阿默农的死，也不再难过了。
